title: LNA Partners with BTRC for Telecom and Digital Innovation Fair 2025
excerpt: Lead Nation Academy served as the Strategic Partner for the Telecom and Digital Innovation Fair 2025, organized by the Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC).
author: LNA Team
coverImageAlt: LNA and BTRC officials at the Telecom and Digital Innovation Fair 2025

blocks.text: Lead Nation Academy (LNA) was proud to serve as the Strategic Partner for the Telecom and Digital Innovation Fair 2025, organized by the Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC).

As the Strategic Partner, LNA took the lead in full event planning, jury board support, and overall coordination, ensuring the smooth execution of this prestigious national event. This collaboration highlights LNA’s commitment to empowering innovation, fostering collaboration between academia, industry, and government bodies, and creating meaningful opportunities for the next generation of digital leaders.

blocks.alt: BTRC Telecom and Digital Innovation Fair 2025 coordination session
blocks.caption: LNA leadership coordinating event operations and jury panels with BTRC

blocks.text: Through this strategic alignment, LNA worked alongside telecom regulators, university innovators, and tech industry executives to evaluate forward-looking digital initiatives and promote industry-ready technical talent across Bangladesh.

title: LNA Signs Strategic Partnership with Canadian University of Bangladesh (CUB)
excerpt: Lead Nation Academy (LNA) and Canadian University of Bangladesh (CUB) officially signed a partnership agreement aimed at bridging the industry-academia gap.
author: LNA Team
coverImageAlt: LNA and Canadian University of Bangladesh leadership signing the partnership agreement

blocks.text: On July 28, 2025, Lead Nation Academy (LNA) and Canadian University of Bangladesh (CUB) officially signed a partnership agreement aimed at bridging the industry-academia gap.

blocks.alt: CUB and LNA representatives exchanging documents
blocks.caption: Official signing and document exchange at CUB campus

blocks.text: This collaboration focuses on equipping students with practical corporate skills, professional development workshops, and direct industry exposure, preparing graduates to excel in competitive workplace environments.

blocks.alt: CUB leadership and LNA team group photograph
blocks.caption: Faculty members and LNA executive leadership at Canadian University of Bangladesh

blocks.text: Through joint initiatives, CUB students will gain access to mentorship from top corporate directors, real-world case simulations, and structured evaluation-to-hiring pathways.

title: Industry Readiness Graduate Program (IRGP) Introduced at AIUB | Powered by AIUB ICE × Lead Nation Academy
excerpt: American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB) Institute of Continuing Education (ICE) and Lead Nation Academy launched the Industry Readiness Graduate Program (IRGP) with an on-spot recruitment drive.
author: LNA Team
coverImageAlt: AIUB ICE and Lead Nation Academy IRGP launch event at AIUB campus

blocks.text: On 27th November 2025, the Institute of Continuing Education (ICE) at American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB), in collaboration with Lead Nation Academy, organized an orientation and on-spot recruitment session for the Industry Readiness Graduate Program (IRGP) at the AIUB Campus.

The event witnessed enthusiastic participation from students and distinguished guests, including university administrators, faculty, and corporate executives. The session featured comprehensive briefings by LNA mentors on practical corporate readiness, communication mastery, and career roadmapping.

blocks.alt: Students attending the IRGP booth at AIUB campus
blocks.caption: Enthusiastic students submitting CVs at the LNA information booth

blocks.text: A key highlight of the event was the on-the-spot internship and recruitment drive arranged by LNA: over 100 CVs were submitted at the booth, and 40 students participated in real-time interviews on campus with partner companies.

blocks.caption: Real-time interviews conducted by industry evaluators

blocks.text: Through IRGP, AIUB ICE and Lead Nation Academy aim to enhance employability, strengthen workplace readiness, and empower students with the capabilities needed to excel in a competitive corporate marketplace.
